To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Yb:CALY0 crystal can be used as an active medium in a chirped pulse RA with a large spectral bandwidth.

(i) we have developed a novel technique for seeding of chirped-pulse RA based on the use of a broadband optical parametric generator (OPG) and a chirped-pulse optical parametric amplifier (OPA), (ii) we have demonstrated the first experimental results of the Yb:CALYOs-based chirped-pulse regenerative amplifier seeded by broadband pulses, (iii) we have achieved the amplification of the broadband pulses with a spectral bandwidth of 60 nm F
1) Broad-band seeded chirped pulses Yb:CALYOs RA can provide near-transform limited pulses (0.4nm FWHM) with the spectral width up to 40nm FWHM.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following topics: (i) the influence of the pump energy and the seed power on the output energy and the pulse duration; (ii) the influence of spectral filtering on the amplified pulse bandwidth; (iii) the influence of chirp on the amplified pulse duration.
the development of a novel femtosecond RA system with broad bandwidth.
the investigation of a Yb:CALYOS-based chirped pulse regenerative amplifier seeded by broad-band pulses.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the Yb:CALYOs are a promising material for ultrafast amplifiers and the RA system with broad-band seeded pulses can provide high energy (up to 1.5 mJ) and high peak power (up to 2.5 GW) near-transform-limited pulses (1.2 ps) with broad spectrum (60 nm).
a large amount of the Yb-based RA systems were seeded by narrow-band (≤15nm) pulses.
Yb:CALYOs are a promising candidate for the development of high power, ultra-short pulse, multi-wavelength, high repetition rate, high average power, and high peak power laser systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have successfully demonstrated a Yb:CALY0 regenerative amplifier that is seeded by a 60 nm FWHH broad-band pulses and amplified to 1 mJ energy level.
the RA with Yb:CALYOG crystal as active media and with the broad-band seeded pulses demonstrated a high efficiency and a good stability.

the Yb:CALYOs-based RA seeded by 60 nm pulses demonstrated the highest pulse energy (1.3 mJ) among all the Yb-based RA systems with similar parameters (pump pulse energy, repetition rate) and the highest pulse energy for the RA seeded by broad band pulses (up to 0.6mJ) among all known Yb-based RA.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Yb:CALYOs-based RA can provide the amplification of the seed pulses with the spectrum of 60 nm FWHF with 3.5 dB of the gain and 2.2 dB of the output saturation.
the Yb:CALYOs RA can be used for amplification of broad-band pulses with the bandwidth of 50nm.

the use of broad-band seed pulses allows one to increase the amplified pulse energy by a factor of ~1.7 and the pulse peak power by a factor of 1.5 in comparison with the RA seeded by narrow-band pulses.
